消えるきえる
  • 1-danintransitive
      • to disappear
      • to vanish
      • to go out of sight
      • to go away
      • to become lost

      • to go out (of a fire, light, etc.)
      • to die
      • to turn off (e.g. of a TV screen)

      • to fade (of a feeling, impression, etc.)
      • to vanish (e.g. of hope)
      時じ間かんがたつにつれて我々われわれの希き望ぼうは消きえた。
      As time went on, our hopes sank.[3]
      • to go away (e.g. of a smell, itchiness, sleepiness)
      • to disappear
      • to fade away (e.g. of footsteps)
      その音おん楽がくの音おとはしだいに消きえていった。

      • to wear away (e.g. of an inscription)
      • to rub out (of writing)
      • to fade (e.g. of ink)
      文もん句くが消きえないように、消きえないインクを使つかってくれませんか。

      • to be lost (e.g. of a tradition)
      • to die out
      • to disappear

      Fashions grow old and die.[6]
